scope: Visual comparison notes from exact-size static room boards.

findings.note: Counter surface/ornament and small bench/stool proportions differ. Merchant, wall/display bays, counter footprint, rug footprint and right-side fixtures align closely. Original PR image has customers/dialogue omitted from the static candidate.

The floor grain was enlarged in the final composite and now reads closer to the reference square-stone pitch. Three red/white seat-like forms along the reference wall-floor seam still differ in silhouette/detail from the candidate; their exact identity is uncertain. The rug is somewhat narrower and bed proportions differ slightly; these remain visual deltas, not exact-layout claims.

Throne pair, party and attendant positions align reasonably. Candidate gold carpet border is bolder/larger, and stone sidewalls are brighter/yellower than the actual PR crop. Dialogue/menu overlays are excluded from the source crop.
